articles.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
articles.excerpt: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls.  It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet

articles.title: xAI releases Grok-4.3 with native long-horizon agent scaffolding
articles.excerpt: New model demonstrates 4.2× improvement on multi-step software engineering benchmarks and sustains coherent agent trajectories beyond 110k tokens.

articles.title: Figure 03 completes 43-hour autonomous factory shift with zero interventions
articles.excerpt: Humanoid achieves new milestone in unsupervised operation, performing 1,240 unique tasks across three assembly lines at the BMW South Carolina plant.

articles.title: Anthropic publishes unprecedented mechanistic interpretability map of Claude 4
articles.excerpt: Researchers reverse-engineered 312 million features inside the model, including the first clear "deception circuit" discovered in a frontier model.

articles.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
articles.excerpt: Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming.  A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 pe...

articles.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
articles.excerpt: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. 33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context
